# fast/ fixtures (SYNTHETIC)

Answers shaped like the WebTic JSON services, for `tests/fetch-prices-fast.test.mjs`:
`scheduling-5065.json` (getFullScheduling), `tickets-<performanceId>.json`
(getPurchaseTicketsInfo) and `data.json` (a tiny invented showtimes file).
Titles, ids and every amount are invented. Do not read them as real prices.
